liveDiscoveredFixesAndLimits: The private CLI requires its matching Code Mode host for real model tool execution; CLI-only synthetic testing was insufficient. Both are now installed and validated.

The actual direct TypeSafe configuration Choice can contain cent-rounded probabilities with a sum of 0.99 or 1.01. The existing Gateway-only guard now applies to both providers only for configuration selection: cent-quantized values, feasible unit mass, invariant unique winner across rounding intervals; raw probabilities preserved. Capability Choice, Nouls and quality/cost policy checks remain strict. No normalization or retry.

Test fixture corrections use the actual available baseline, native rename before the test to avoid an ephemeral title helper, actual unifiedExecStartup tool origin, and a passive observer that does not instrument unrelated Node quota probes. These are not production fallback paths.
The final passive installed live gate contains no temporary response-clone diagnostic wrapper. Prior failed attempts and source-only successes are not substituted for final installed evidence.
Final full suites were run against frozen production assets. Earlier parallel deadline flakes and changing embedded asset snapshots are not counted as passes.

changedFileGroups.purpose: Pinned private native input queue, atomic new-turn contract, reproducible runtime pair and honest host origin
Verified private launch, request ownership/lifecycle, atomic model-plus-effort submission and narrowly guarded configuration probabilities
Embedded asset and regression coverage, real native PTY and actual installed Jev/inference verification
Completed behavior, installation evidence and explicit limits

simplifications: Use the native UI queue and existing Core idle-only start instead of a second proxy queue, synthetic lifecycle ACKs, held steering or key rebinding.
Resolve one verified private executable for UI, probe and backend instead of selecting separate PATH versions.
Reuse the existing bounded configuration rounding guard for both providers; do not add a probability normalization, retry or dependency layer.
remainingRisks: This proves selected and persisted native model/effort settings, not a server-internal serving attestation or measured quality/cost savings.

Actual live inference covered one available model/effort pair and two turns. Cross-model/effort changes, queue collisions and approvals have deterministic regression coverage, not exhaustive live-provider coverage.
The private native patch is pinned to upstream 0.162.1 and must be rebased and reverified on upgrades; its local dev-small CLI is not an optimized distribution build.

The matching official prebuilt Code Mode host was compatibility-tested through actual tool execution, but its pinned source build and upstream host stdio suite were unavailable because the V8 artifact returned 404.
Existing MindPlayer processes/panes are not hot-patched. Claude/Kiro/Cursor are outside this private Codex queue change.
Default suites intentionally skip credential-consuming and experimental opt-ins; the specific real Jev/native and installed smoke gates listed above were run separately.
